items.headline: The Fairhaven quote — the one you parked on Friday — needs a number today
items.body: They asked twice and the second ask copied their operations lead, which is the tell that it has moved off the maybe pile. The machine list has not changed since the walkthrough, so the only open item is what you want the freight line to read. Nothing else in the inbox is waiting on you this morning.

items.headline: Three weeks of half-finished notes are all the same note
items.body: The Tuesday captures keep circling the same decision and none of them ends in one. That is a signal about the decision, not about the note-taking: it has no owner and no date, so it regenerates every week. Give it either and it stops.
